what: Round 1 of the spec gate blocked before any lens: the conductor ran the spec-producer inline having loaded the two format bars and the three actor bars, but not the lifecycle and gate-validation governances, and not the plugin-tier builder-spec bar the project registry names for artifact-type skill. Same failure mode as CR 35 round 1. All three loaded and composed before round 2.

Composing the plugin-tier builder bar surfaced two shipped rules with no scenario: the doubt rule that resolves an uncertain coverage reading toward covered, and the bar confining the skill to local agent configuration. One scenario added for each; the second authored as a barred row rather than a use-case extension, since no decision in the drawn graph can reach a file outside the agent configuration.

The impl gate passed, then a blind re-run of the stale fixture after a style tightening flipped it from earlier-form to covered. The run's own reasoning named the defect: the stale criterion opened with a prose sentence describing what an earlier form is, above the two mechanical conditions, so the conditions read as necessary but not sufficient and the agent fell back to comparing sentences. A rewrite's sentences always differ, so that comparison can only conclude not-an-earlier-form. Rule: a criterion an agent applies must state whether its listed conditions are decisive. Swept the sibling coverage criterion in the same file, which already reads decisively. Rewritten so the two conditions are the whole test, with the narrowness of the conditions carrying the owner's-own-prose safety instead of a freehand override.

Impl gate round 2 returned change on the safety scenario. The judge built a plausible independently-authored delegation section that met both stale conditions and got offered a replacement. Its diagnosis was right and the conductor had missed it: the self-gating opening clause is carried by the current text as well as the earlier one, so it discriminated nothing, and silence about model inheritance is the default state of any unrelated prose rather than a mark of provenance. Rule: a criterion that claims a text descends from a known source must test for something nobody writes independently, not for a reusable phrasing plus a missing detail. Rewritten as three conditions where the first is a character-for-character span present in both the outgoing and incoming wording, establishing provenance, and the other two select the version. The instruction not to re-weigh sentences was scoped to the section body so it cannot license paraphrase-matching a condition.

Impl gate round 3 returned change on the safety scenario again, on a new input class the round-2 fix did not anticipate: a section quoting the provenance span in order to argue against it. The condition tested whether the span was present, not whether it was asserted, and the instruction against reconsidering sentences made a blind run suppress its own correct read that the prose was the owner's. Rule: a provenance test on quoted text must ask whether the text is asserted or shown. The skill already applies exactly that rule one step earlier, where a heading inside a fenced block is not a heading, so the condition now says a quoted or disputed span is not an asserted one, and that reading which it is belongs to matching the condition rather than to the sentence comparison ruled out below it.

Impl gate round 4 returned change on the safety scenario and classified it a recurrence rather than a new class, correctly. The provenance condition accepted either of two spans, and the rule stated one round earlier was applied only to the first: the second is an ordinary triad any team writes unprompted, and blind runs on plausible in-house guidance built around it offered to replace the owner's words. Treated as a re-plan rather than another patch: the rule was swept across every span shared by the outgoing and incoming wordings instead of applied to the one the judge named. Four survive both, exactly one is distinctive, so the condition now accepts that one and the disjunction is gone. A provenance test is only as strong as its weakest accepted match.

Impl gate round 5 failed the safety scenario for the fourth time and classified it a second consecutive recurrence of the provenance class. Stopped per the stopping rule stated to the judge rather than producing a round 6. The finding is no longer about which span is chosen: the judge argues the span-matching mechanism cannot close the class, because any quotable phrase can be reproduced by someone who has read this package's docs or another repository it enhanced. Verified independently and it holds — the currently chosen span appears verbatim in an unrelated instruction file on this machine, maintained by hand and never written by this skill. Choosing the replacement mechanism is a product decision about who the feature serves, and one candidate would need a frozen scenario narrowed, so it is escalated rather than self-asserted.

Impl gate failed one frozen scenario three runs of three. The criterion stated two binary predicates and enumerated three of their four combinations; the fourth, a sentence-for-sentence reword keeping the order, had no rule, and every run improvised into a branch the frozen suite forbade. Owner chose to route it to the undecided branch, which reopened the suite a second time. The rule is now stated in closed form over both predicates rather than as an enumeration, with a totality clause promoted into the rule so both predicates are total and the four cases exhaustive. Rule: a rule stated over two conditions must cover all four combinations, and saying when they agree they decide is shorter and safer than listing cases.

The spec judge found the pre-repair proof had been run against the pre-repair implementation, which grader independence puts out of view at the spec gate. The proof's object is the pre-repair contract, and on that object it holds decisively: the retired scenario and its replacement demand opposite verdicts on one constructible state. The behavioural agreement flagged as cutting against the repair was instead evidence the implementation was already non-conforming to the contract it was frozen under. Recording the correction so the proof is not cited from the wrong instrument later.

Impl gate found the short-circuit ahead of the two questions keyed on the subject a section talks about rather than on where the section came from. Appending one sentence about choosing a model to a byte-identical retired wording suppressed the comparison and the refresh was never offered, three runs of three. Recurrence of this mission's own second lesson, a provenance test must key on something nobody writes independently, applied to the two questions but not to the shortcut in front of them. Removed rather than repaired: the two questions already answer no and no for a section that really is the current wording, since none of the current wording's sentences and none of its shape come from a retired one, so it reaches offer-nothing by the ordinary route. Verified there is no whole-sentence overlap between the current and retired wordings before deleting. The frozen suite is untouched; only the map edge for one scenario moved.

Impl gate accepted the shortcut deletion on the suite and failed it structurally. Deleting the guard was half right: keying it on the subject a section discusses was the defect, but removing every guard left the node correct only by an accident of the current corpus, since the current and retired wordings happen to share no whole sentence. That expires at the next revision, when the text current today becomes retired and every up to date repository starts being compared against the text it was derived from, which reads as stale. Rule: when a special case is deleted because the general rule covers it, the subsumption must be a property of the mechanism, not of the data currently in the corpus. The guard is back, keyed on identity with the text the node would offer, which is a stored artifact exactly as the retired ones are. Verified by simulating the post revision corpus with two retired wordings and an up to date consumer. Named as its own outcome rather than folded into the owner's own, since crediting a person with text this package wrote is the same misattribution the capability exists to prevent.

Third instance in this mission of a mechanism correct for today's corpus and wrong for another. The identity guard and a shared-sentence discount were each sound only for some revision shapes: a rewritten sentence, a dropped one and an added one each break a different part, and every fix considered opened the next. The owner chose to stop specifying behaviour for revisions that do not exist and to verify each revision when it is made: a change retiring a wording must add scenarios for its revision shape and pass the gate against the new pair. The discount and its speculative guard scenario were removed. Two defects reachable today were fixed regardless: a section holding the current text and a retired sentence together was reported current, and the current text split by an owner paragraph was credited to the owner. Also found the skill body had never carried the current-text check at all, because an earlier edit mangled the line and two later edits silently failed to match it.

The spec judge found the two earlier spec gate lines for owner-cleared reopens recorded the approval as the agent's, and that the placement narrowing cannot meet the Clearance repair proof because removing an assertion never makes the pre-repair contract fail. Those gate lines stand as written, the ledger being append-only; this line records that both reopens were cleared by the repository owner in session, not self-asserted, and the next gate line attributes them accordingly.

ACED impl judge passed all forty-three frozen scenarios and returned change on the structural read: the docs page still described the already-current guard as the resemblance check the owner replaced, while the same page described containment correctly further up. Recurrence of the stale-description class. Swept for the rule rather than the instance: five descriptions across the docs page, the changeset, the history file header and two lines of the node README still stated the superseded mechanism or contradicted the guard, and all were corrected. Two clarifying sentences were added to the skill body and reference for behaviour every blind run already showed: a named root is the repository, and a quoted sentence does not count for the first question.
